claims: Saint Patrick's Day is celebrated annually on March 17th.
Saint Patrick's Day honors the patron saint of Ireland.
Saint Patrick's Day was originally a religious feast day.
Saint Patrick's Day commemorates St. Patrick's 5th-century mission to bring Christianity to Ireland.
According to legend, St. Patrick used the three-leaf shamrock to explain the Holy Trinity.
St. Patrick is mythologized for driving snakes out of Ireland.
The shamrock is a small, three-leaved clover.
The shamrock serves as a symbol of St. Patrick's Day.
The shamrock is commonly worn as a sprig on St. Patrick's Day.
St. Patrick's Day parades have been held in New York since 1762.
The river in Chicago is dyed green on St. Patrick's Day.
People wear green on St. Patrick's Day to avoid being pinched by leprechauns.
Irish soda bread is a traditional St. Patrick's Day meal.
Lamb stew is a traditional St. Patrick's Day meal.
Corned beef and cabbage is a traditional St. Patrick's Day meal in America.
Britannica and this YouTube video say March 17th is believed to be the date of St. Patrick's death.
